Record pass when loaded.
r0-context.finding: Loaded inherited/project doctrine, G3 handoff/frozen imperative/result, exact seven-path inventory/helper, all live role doctrine/templates/tests, and G1/G2 public contracts. r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change do what the handoff asked, within its allowed scope? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r1-handoff.finding: BLOCK: the claimed operative chain is not executable in shipped installs and is mostly marker-attested. Installed-layout probe resolves 0/4 directive template paths because source-relative ../replan and ../to-initial-issues omit installed constellation-* names. Explorer c3 is check:null and never verifies the produced SHAPED_BRIEF.json. Commander names no REPLAN_INPUT output path and c2 is check:null, so no packet is validated. Admiral c3 is check:null at end of the whole execute step, so directives/prose do not enforce one verified exit before each launch or verify/render actual packets. Existing tests assert directive dictionaries and validate unrelated checked-in fixtures, so these failures remain green.

r2-scope.title: Scope drift
r2-scope.imperative: Did the change stay inside allowed scope and respect specific exclusions? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r2-scope.finding: The exact seven-path digest inventory is confined to Explorer, Commander, Admiral doctrine/spines and one focused test. No G1/G2 schema, engine, tracker implementation, alias, archive/history, external provenance, or G4 artifact changed; no network write path was added.

r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it actually demonstrate the behavior? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r3-evidence.finding: Both required suites reproduce (31 passed; 76 passed/59 subtests), all three JSON spines parse, digest and scoped diff check pass, and no new executable network path exists. BLOCK: evidence is marker/fixture-satisfiable. Tests assert directive literals and separately validate canonical checked-in G1/G2 templates; they never resolve installed paths, materialize/verify Explorer or Commander run outputs, or prove an Admiral transition is verified before a subsequent launch. Reviewer installed-layout probe fails all 4 paths.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: The change is minimal, readable, preserves negative-space boundaries, and avoids schema/engine churn, but it fails the inherited executable-interface/two-bin rule: structured paths break after install and the new run invariants are null-attested prose/directives rather than commands or actual artifact checks. r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from the recorded architecture in a way Commander must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag a triage candidate if it is out of scope.
r5-reconciliation.finding: No architecture map exists and the seven structural files are accurately named. BLOCK: Map Impact overstates capability as live exact contract seams. In the installed corpus all four structured paths are unresolved, and the spines do not mechanically consume/verify named artifacts at the claimed boundaries. This is in-scope G3 reconciliation, not triage.

r6-fowler.title: Refactoring pass (Fowler code smells)
r6-fowler.imperative: Run the refactoring / code-smell pass (SKILL.md 'Refactoring pass'). Render a verdict on each Fowler baseline smell (long method, large class, duplicated code, feature envy, data clumps, primitive obsession, long parameter list, shotgun surgery, divergent change, message chains, speculative generality, comments-as-deodorant): flagged / overridden / absent. Smells are judgment calls, ALWAYS subordinate to the repo's documented standards — an override needs a logged standard + reason. Record the pass to templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json, run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py <record> (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. Do NOT silently skip this item.
constraints: Fowler smells are subordinate to documented repo standards; never hard violations
an override (smell not flagged because a standard wins) needs a logged reason
r6-fowler.finding: Fowler rail passed 12/12. BLOCKING speculative-generality: directives objects look executable but no engine/role machinery consumes them; all new artifact/timing postconditions are check:null and tests assert metadata plus separate fixtures. Duplicated Markdown/directive mirrors and finite three-role surgery are explicitly overridden by the frozen role-contract requirement.

r4a-paths.imperative: Resolve every structured cross-skill template/helper path from the installed role root and require the referenced public artifact to exist.

r4b-explorer.imperative: Exercise an Explorer confirmation output through exact G1 shaped-brief verification and field/evidence retention, not a checked-in fixture alone.

No command reads .agent-work/<work-id>/SHAPED_BRIEF.json through verify_shaped_brief, so malformed or missing actual output can be attested while the fixture-only seam test remains green.

r4c-commander.imperative: Exercise a named Commander output packet through exact G2 input verification and prove discrepancies cannot be auto-filed.

No actual Commander packet is materialized or passed to verify_replan_input; the test only validates the canonical template fixture.
